description: Legacy percentage-format template: x/y are 0-100 percentages of the card, no settings.fields_format marker.
provenance: Format described by includes/functions.php:1305-1312 ('Convert legacy percentage-based field positions to pixel positions'), which is the only in-repo definition of the legacy shape. Field key set and styling keys copied from the stock template builder at admin/save_template.php:233-256. Percentages chosen so each field lands outside the 50-80 guard band of includes/functions.php:1326 so BOTH engines agree it is a percentage - this fixture isolates D2/D4, not D1.
